# Independent frozen evidence archive review — 2026-11-21

Reviewer: `/root/frontend_compilation_21`.

**PASS — no custody, inventory or recognizable-secret findings.** This review
reads the frozen packet and retained originals. It performs no native test
rerun and changes no archive, manifest, repository document, source input or
workflow. This report and its JSON companion are saved outside the packet.
The complete Docs Protocol is a separate root-owned validation, not claimed by
this custody review.

## Frozen packet identity and safe inventory

`docs/research/evidence/plugin-update-runtimes-20261121.tar.gz`:

- Compressed bytes: **17,266,914**.
- SHA-256: `873a2c7aa48d49211a3d93a2a11d886a8cd46062283c875b4240494fb4e9a184`.
- Manifest SHA-256: `492dbdefc9d35317d1b9d18bf744e29be4dd020af51a9ccf95e4116288b0574b`.
- **368 regular members**, expanded total **18,803,140 bytes**.
- Largest member: **7,933,388 bytes**, below 8 MiB.

Every member has a unique normalized relative path, including uniqueness under
case folding. No absolute paths, traversal segments, backslashes, drive prefixes,
links or nonregular entries. The member set exactly equals the manifest; every
size and SHA-256 matches; every retained member also equals its scratch original
byte for byte. No extraction into the repository was required.

The packet contains no dependency installation/cache, credential-file paths or
upstream implementation trees. Large Wasm/component binaries and generated
Wasm JavaScript glue occur only inside the original ZIPs; their adjacent custody
JSON still lists every original entry. Selected decoded inputs, logs, result
receipts and generated declarations match their original ZIP bytes. The five
files under `wasm/attribution/` are retained license/attribution material and
are not misclassified as an upstream implementation tree.

## Six original artifacts retained and fully bound

For each original ZIP, recomputed size and digest against both the retained
official GitHub artifact metadata and its custody record. Checked unique safe
ZIP paths and no symlinks, then checked every entry's bytes/size/hash against
the complete custody list. No ZIP entry is omitted from that list.

| Run | Profile | Artifact ID | ZIP bytes | ZIP entries | Outcome retained |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 44922588804 | Frontend | 14714835163 | 168,029 | 41 | Profile passed; whole workflow failed |
| 44922588804 | Wasm | 14714407273 | 35,517 | 24 | WIT filesystem build failure |
| 44923955219 | Frontend | 14714054072 | 166,842 | 41 | Profile passed; whole workflow failed |
| 44923955219 | Wasm | 14714771908 | 7,932,331 | 49 | Build passed; positive host-import control failed |
| 44924688888 | Frontend | 14715381698 | 168,525 | 41 | Passed |
| 44924688888 | Wasm | 14715018254 | 7,933,388 | 50 | Passed |

All six full SHA-256 values and source commit bindings are recorded in
`archive-review.json`. The final profile results are preserved exactly:
frontend 1 E2E / 31 matching comparisons; Wasm 1 E2E / 19 matching comparisons
and five expected rejections. Both final job conclusions are successful.
Both instrumented Wasm compiler-load arrays are empty. The prior two failed
whole workflows are not reclassified by the final pass.

## Three input revisions retain their exact source relationships

Every input tar has 25 safe unique regular source/config members, all checked
against its own manifest. For each associated run/profile, checked the ZIP's
input receipt commit/run/attempt/profile and archive digest, exact manifest
declaration, and each source byte: 14 frontend inputs and 11 Wasm inputs.

## Final report, content review and workflow identity

The repository's final report
`docs/research/live-update-policies-and-portable-runtimes-2026-11-21.md` is
byte-identical to retained `root/review-inputs/root-final.md` and the scratch

## Previous research remains unchanged

Checked all five November 14/17/18 tar archives against both current HEAD
`118e2d226b0daed23e9fdbbbb5c1366da2880ad9` and the initial task commit
`d1d307f0fdbe99c7f0e985c0b43375972cfa3386` using exact Git blob identities.
Every archive matches both baselines. Their SHA-256 values are also recorded in

## Bounded secret review and audit limitation

Scanned **356 UTF-8 outer members** and **227 UTF-8 entries inside original
ZIPs** for private-key markers, recognizable GitHub/Slack tokens, AWS access
identifiers, unmasked authorization values, signed-download credentials and
assigned authentication secrets. No matches. Forbidden credential/cache/source
inventory paths also yielded no findings. Masked GitHub job-log credentials are
not treated as disclosed secrets. This is a bounded recognizable-pattern and
inventory review, not a proof that arbitrary secrets cannot exist in another
encoding or in a binary.

The first nested audit stopped on the reviewer's attempted lookup of
`root/synthesis-draft.md`, a duplicate intentionally omitted from the packet.
The corrected audit used the actual retained `root/review-inputs/root-final.md`
and independently compared it with both the repository report and scratch draft.
This was a reviewer lookup correction, not a failed product test, missing final
report or packet mutation. The successful complete audit records all checks
above; no native evidence was rerun.
